text.div:
Florida Blue BlueOptions 03768 - Prime EPO Plan

Carrier: GatorCare. Plan type: EPO. Period: 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31.

25 benefits are placed in CARIN SBC benefit categories. 4 benefits have no code in the SBC benefit category code system and are listed, by identity only, in the bps-unmapped-benefit extension.

Converted from Benefit Plan Standard document GATORCARE_PRIME_EPO (schema version 1.1.0).

extension.valueString: BlueOptions 03768 - Coverage Period: 01/01/2026 - 12/31/2026 | Prime EPO Plan | Coverage for: Individual and/or Family | Plan Type: PPO. (GatorCare self-funded plan administered by Florida Blue; the document carries the administrator's branding and group number.)
What is the overall deductible? In-Network: GatorCare: Tier 1 $350 Per Person/$700 Family. BlueOptions Tier 2 $700 Per Person/$1,400 Family.

What is the out-of-pocket limit for this plan? Yes. In-Network: GatorCare Tier 1: $2,700 Per Person/$5,400 Family /BlueOptions Tier 2: $3,500 Per Person/$7,000 Family. (This example carries the Tier 1 accumulators; Tier 2 is stated here.)
Are there other deductibles for specific services? Yes. BlueOptions Tier 2 $750 Per Admission Hospital. GatorCare Tier 1: $150. BlueOptions Tier 2 / Tier 3 $250 Per ER Visit.
Primary care visit to treat an injury or illness: $15 Copay per Visit (Tier 1); Tier 2/Tier 3: Not Covered
Preventive care/screening/immunization: No Charge, Deductible does not apply (Tier 1)
Imaging (CT/PET scans, MRIs): Physician Office: $35 Copay per Visit/ Independent Diagnostic Testing Center: 10% Coinsurance. (The example carries the physician-office value.)

Generic drugs / Preferred brand drugs / Non-preferred brand drugs / Specialty drugs: Not Covered. (Prescription drugs are covered under GatorCare's separate pharmacy benefit, documented in its own pharmacy SBC.)
Outpatient surgery - Facility fee: Ambulatory Surgical Center: 10% Coinsurance/ Hospital: Deductible + 10% Coinsurance. Physician/surgeon fees: Deductible + 10% Coinsurance

Emergency room care: $150 Per Visit Deductible + Tier 1 Deductible + 10% Coinsurance (Tier 1); $250 Per Visit Deductible + Tier 2 Deductible + 10% Coinsurance (Tier 2/Tier 3). (This file marks emergency room care as covered in both columns and carries none of these amounts.)
Urgent care: $35 Copay per Visit, Tier 1 UF Health owned/affiliated; $50 Copay per Visit, Tier 1 Non UF Health owned/affiliated. (The example carries the UF Health-affiliated value.)
Hospital stay - Facility fee: Deductible + 10% Coinsurance. Physician/surgeon fees: Deductible + 10% Coinsurance
Mental health outpatient services: Physician Office: $35 Copay per Visit / Hospital: Deductible + 10% Coinsurance. Inpatient services: Deductible + 10% Coinsurance
Childbirth/delivery professional services: Deductible + 10% Coinsurance. Childbirth/delivery facility services: Hospital: Deductible + 10% Coinsurance
Home health care: 10% Coinsurance. Coverage limited to 30 visits.
Rehabilitation services: Physician Office: $35 Copay per Visit/ Outpatient Rehab Center: 10% Coinsurance. Coverage limited to 75 visits including 26 manipulations.
Habilitation services: Not Covered. Skilled nursing care: Deductible + 10% Coinsurance, limited to 60 days. Hospice services: Deductible + 10% Coinsurance.
Children's eye exam: Not Covered. Children's glasses: Not Covered. Children's dental check-up: Not Covered.

Services Your Plan Generally Does NOT Cover: Acupuncture, Generic drugs, Preferred brand drugs, Non-preferred brand drugs, Habilitation services, Pediatric dental check-up, Pediatric eye exam, Pediatric glasses
Other Covered Services: Bariatric surgery, Chiropractic care, Infertility Services
